name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos + Darknut PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.18 DARKNUT MINIBOSS FIX09 (DKN01): the normal Darknut of Enemy Spawner only (B_TN 0x000001FF): phase 1 with 600 HP, posture 200 and progressive armour, phases 2/3 with 480 resistance and posture 160/180; FIX09: Link's jump attack is no longer absorbed by a hidden native dodge timer (it hits, is evaded or is blocked from the front), the Darknut never blocks while it jumps away, its side / back evasions give 6 ticks (0.20 s) of invulnerability from the take-off and nothing more, after hurting Link's life it finishes its attack naturally (the second cut of a double never comes) and then holds its ground or jumps back (more often when its health or posture run low), evasions slightly more frequent when weakened, no false shield clank on Link's parries; every FIX08 rule and every other enemy unchanged.
